overview_description.description: Lightspeed Commerce develops a unified point of sale and payments platform for retail and hospitality businesses. Its cloud solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financing, and connection to supplier networks. The platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide customer experiences.

product.name: Lightspeed Retail
product.description: A cloud-based point-of-sale and commerce platform for retailers, supporting in-store, online, mobile, and multi-location sales.

product.name: Lightspeed Restaurant
product.description: A cloud-based restaurant point-of-sale platform for managing menus, orders, payments, tables, inventory, and multi-location operations.

product.name: Lightspeed Payments
product.description: An integrated payment-processing service that lets retail, restaurant, and golf businesses accept payments and reconcile transactions through Lightspeed.

product.name: Lightspeed Golf
product.description: A cloud-based golf course management platform covering tee times, point of sale, payments, bookings, websites, apps, reporting, and marketing.

product.name: Lightspeed eCommerce
product.description: An online commerce solution that connects digital storefronts with Lightspeed retail operations, inventory, and in-person sales.

product.name: Lightspeed Inventory Management
product.description: Inventory management software for tracking products, purchasing, transfers, stock levels, and demand across locations and sales channels.
